result.summary: Direct free kick taken by the attacking team in white attacking the goal to the left against an opponent in dark shirts. The free kick taker curls a right-footed strike over the defensive wall into the top left corner of the net for a goal.

observations.title: Set piece alignment and wall setup
observations.body: The defending team establishes a four-man wall outside the box to protect the near post side. The goalkeeper sets up central-to-right to cover the far side, leaving the top left corner vulnerable to a curled strike.

observations.title: Direct strike execution
observations.body: The set piece taker approaches with a controlled run-up and executes a right-footed curled delivery over the wall. The ball stays on an upward trajectory with sufficient dip to beat the goalkeeper toward the top left corner.

observations.title: Goal confirmed
observations.body: The ball settles into the upper left corner of the net as the goalkeeper's diving attempt fails to reach it. The attacking players immediately turn to celebrate the goal.
